papers.title: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
papers.summary: Tree-Ising repairs reasoning loops in LLM weights by solving sparse Ising/QUBO problems over BF16 parameters, improving math benchmark accuracy with fewer weight edits and no gradient or LLM-token cost.
papers.summary_zh: 用稀疏Ising/QUBO求解修复LLM权重中的推理循环，少量比特编辑即可提升数学基准成绩，无需梯度。

papers.title: Few-Step Streaming Video Generation via Condition Shifting
papers.summary: APEX extends a streaming video generation method by replacing a separate fake-score network with condition shifting to estimate the generated distribution’s velocity field, improving instruction following and visual aesthetics while reducing memory and iteration time relative to DMD.
papers.summary_zh: APEX用条件偏移代替独立假分数网络估计速度场，改进少步流式视频生成，提升指令遵循与画质，并比DMD更省显存、更快。

papers.title: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
papers.summary: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the wor
papers.summary_zh: 针对上下文学习在机器人操作中弱于训练策略的问题，为异场景演示引入环境反馈，避免技能与数据分布绑定。

papers.title: Don't Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents
papers.summary: WikiTrace links each distilled lesson to its source trajectory and rationale, enabling LLM agents to verify and correct memories before acting, improving performance and reducing memory-induced degradation across agentic benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: WikiTrace将每条提炼的经验与其来源轨迹和理由关联，让LLM智能体在行动前校验并修正记忆，减少记忆导致的性能退化。

papers.title: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
papers.summary: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budget
papers.summary_zh: 提出Infrathon基准，在24小时预算下评测智能体对真实AI基础设施进行长时程优化的能力，测试六个模型共150次运行。

papers.title: dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representations
papers.summary: A discrete native-resolution vision transformer with grouped product quantization and a dual-branch objective acts as a versatile visual tokenizer, matching or exceeding task-specific baselines across visual understanding, generation, and editing tasks.
papers.summary_zh: 以分组乘积量化的离散编码作为通用视觉分词器，在理解、生成与编辑任务上媲美或超过专用基线。

papers.title: MMDM: Measuring Massive Multitask Decision Making
papers.summary: System-1 Decision Models directly make structured probabilistic decisions over query-specified options given a state in a single forward pass, without autoregressively generating reasoning trajectories or textual responses. Recent evaluations cover diverse tasks but often rely on existing benchmarks
papers.summary_zh: MMDM评测System-1决策模型在单次前向传播中直接给出结构化概率决策的能力，不依赖自回归生成推理，覆盖多样化任务。

papers.title: DexForesight: Grounding Dexterous Policies with Implicit Spatial Foresight
papers.summary: Dexterous manipulation requires rich spatial foresight over both the surrounding scene and the robot hand. Existing world-action models often acquire such predictive knowledge through explicit future prediction. We introduce DexForesight, a framework that learns spatial foresight implicitly by injec
papers.summary_zh: DexForesight以隐式方式学习空间预见，让灵巧手策略在不显式预测未来的情况下获得场景与手部的空间前瞻能力。

papers.title: MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations
papers.summary: MACaQ is an MXFP4 W4A4 post-training quantization method that quantizes each linear layer independently using online activation transforms and Hessian-aware refinement, reducing cost while preserving accuracy across language and diffusion models.
papers.summary_zh: MACaQ是一种MXFP4 W4A4训练后量化方法，逐层独立量化，结合在线激活变换与Hessian感知精修，在语言和扩散模型上降低成本并保持精度。

papers.title: SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment
papers.summary: World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language. Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation. However, introducing action learning
papers.summary_zh: SWAM指出引入动作学习会破坏预训练得到的语言-视频对齐，提出跨模态对齐方法，以扩展世界动作模型。

papers.title: Embodied First Exam
papers.summary: Early successes on agentic robotics point to a potential paradigm shift toward using coding agents to control robots. Existing robotics benchmarks are built around visuomotor policy learning, leaving it open whether coding agents can reliably control diverse robots under physical-world constraints.
papers.summary_zh: 提出Embodied First Exam基准，检验编码智能体能否在物理约束下可靠控制多种机器人，突破以视觉运动策略为中心的评测。

papers.title: FINCOSMOS: An Open-World Evaluation Paradigm for Agents in Finance
papers.summary: Language agents increasingly work for users on the open Web, and finance is where trusting them is hardest. The data must come from the Web, the strategy lives in the user's head, and correctness depends on time, so an agent can fail silently: a strategy the user never asked for, unverified data, or
papers.summary_zh: FINCOSMOS提出金融开放世界评测范式，考察网络智能体能否获取可靠数据、贴合用户策略并兼顾时效，以发现其静默失败。

papers.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training
papers.summary: How little of a pretrained large language model (LLM) has to change for it to acquire new capabilities? We find that zeroing fewer than 0.05% of its weights, with no other modification, matches full fine-tuning (FFT) at scale across three LLM post-training regimes: reinforcement learning with verifi
papers.summary_zh: 研究发现将LLM中不到0.05%的权重置零，即可在强化学习等后训练中匹配全量微调，说明少量权重改动即可获得新能力。

papers.title: WaveGen: Truly End-to-End Waveform Generation via Internal Spectral Trajectory Learning
papers.summary: WaveGen is a fully end-to-end diffusion framework for text-to-waveform generation that jointly learns spectral and waveform trajectories via Spectral Forcing without external audio codecs, vocoders, latent models, alignment modules, or self-supervised representations, achieving state-of-the-art text-to-speech results.
papers.summary_zh: WaveGen提出端到端文本到波形扩散框架，通过内部频谱轨迹学习，无需外部音频编解码器或声码器，取得领先的文本到波形生成效果。

papers.title: ProTEUS: A mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution
papers.summary: ProTEUS is a mutation-resolved world model that combines sequence, evolutionary, and structural representations with fast all-atom prediction and closed-loop feedback to guide protein evolution and improve mutant activity.
papers.summary_zh: ProTEUS是一种突变解析的世界模型，结合序列、进化与结构表示及全原子快速预测，通过闭环反馈指导蛋白质进化以提升突变体活性。

papers.title: DepthGraft: Structural Regularization through Hierarchical Cross-Layer KV Reconstruction
papers.summary: DepthGraft improves deep language model training by hierarchically sharing key-value representations across layers, reducing memory use while boosting accuracy.
papers.summary_zh: DepthGraft通过分层跨层KV表示共享，在深层语言模型训练中降低显存占用并提升准确率。

papers.title: MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification
papers.summary: Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models can follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. We introduce MotionGraphicsBench, an expert-curated benchmark of
papers.summary_zh: MotionGraphicsBench以程序化验证评测LLM生成动态图形的能力，考察其能否同时满足空间、外观与时序要求。

papers.title: PhyRubric: Rubric-Grounded Diagnostic Evaluation of Physical Commonsense in Text-to-Video Generation
papers.summary: A rubric-based diagnostic benchmark and judge assess physical commonsense in text-to-video generation, showing that current models still struggle and that the judge aligns closely with human judgments.
papers.summary_zh: PhyRubric提出基于评分量规的诊断式评测与评判器，考察文生视频的物理常识，发现当前模型仍有欠缺，且评判器与人类判断高度一致。

papers.title: From Tool State to Scientific Action: Auditing Decision Provenance in Biomedical Research Agents
papers.summary: A scientific agent can give the same verdict while reading and citing different evidence. BioAgent-DF tests this separation using paired reference and candidate values saved at the same scientific computation site. It restores or transplants those values at their original coordinates, then runs the
papers.summary_zh: BioAgent-DF在同一科学计算位置成对替换参考与候选数值，检验生物医学研究智能体的决策溯源，判断其结论究竟基于何种证据。

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling for Diffusion Language Models with Frequency-Aware Remasking
papers.summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, where decisions about which tokens to commit or remask strongly affect output quality. Existing certainty-aware strategies rely on instantaneous confidence or entropy, but these local signals can be misleading on difficult r
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于频率感知重掩码的扩散语言模型测试时缩放方法，改进token提交与重掩码的决策，避免仅依赖瞬时置信度或熵的误判。
